runner: run_simpler_env.py: the loop of SimplerEnv's run_maniskill2_eval_single_episode over the official episode list
note: X-VLA Google Robot, LeRobot port lerobot/xvla-google-robot (of 2toINF/X-VLA-Google-Robot); same server pipeline and image handling as xvla_simpler_widowx; client = simpler_policies.XVLASimplerPolicy with X-VLA's google-VM/VA client logic (domain 1, zero proprio, every second action of the chunk up to 10, positions relative to the last commanded one, gripper closed above 0.25). Absolute EE control (arm_pd_ee_base_pose_align_interpolate_by_planner) from SimplerEnv-absee; official episodes, step limits and success at the last step (X-VLA's clients allow twice the step limit and stop at the first success).
